result.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the blacklist lowercases env entries (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) but guest emails from input are not normalized: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` compares raw case-sensitive strings. A guest email with different casing bypasses the blacklist. The diff shows the mechanism directly.
